items.title: Iran says it has closed Strait of Hormuz over Israeli attacks in Lebanon
items.description: The US military has disputed Tehran's claim, which comes ahead of US-Iran talks in Switzerland on Sunday.

items.title: Lebanese turtle conservationist Mona Khalil killed by Israeli strike
items.description: Mona Khalil, who had refused to leave the beach she had spent years protecting, died from her injuries after the Israeli strike.

items.title: Meloni tells Trump to 'focus on your own popularity' as row escalates
items.description: The US president earlier questioned Meloni's popularity after suggesting she "begged" for a photo at G7 summit

items.title: Israeli strikes kill six people in Gaza including Al Jazeera cameraman, officials say
items.description: The Israeli military accused Ahmed Wishah of being a "Hamas sniper operative", without providing evidence.

items.title: Bolivian president declares state of emergency
items.description: The move comes after weeks of anti-government protests that have caused a shortage of basic goods in Bolivia.

items.title: Zelensky returns highest Polish honour after award stripped
items.description: Ukraine's president said his country was open to "engagement" about "difficult and painful chapters of our shared past".

items.title: Tourist dies in Dominican Republic luxury resort fire
items.description: Nearly 1,700 people were evacuated from the huge blaze at Viva Wyndham Dominicus Beach in Bayahibe, a popular resort town on the Caribbean coast.

items.title: US to stop funding HIV programmes in South Africa
items.description: More than eight million South Africans are living with HIV – the highest number of any country in the world.

items.title: Australia confirms first case of H5N1 bird flu as virus reaches every continent
items.description: Australia was previously the only continent where the H5N1 bird flu strain had not yet been found.

items.title: African and Caribbean nations call for formal apology for transatlantic slavery
items.description: The leaders have asked for apologies from the countries that benefited from the slave trade, as well as debt relief and financial compensation.

items.title: James Burrows, legendary director of Cheers and Friends, dies aged 85
items.description: Best-known as co-creator of sitcom Cheers, Burrows directed more than 1,000 episodes of other classics including the Big Bang Theory and Will and Grace.

items.title: Boy, 12, wins hearts after trying to check sick chicken into Ethiopian hospital
items.description: Markos's beloved hen was not responding to any treatments - so he did the only thing he could think of.
